description: The generic reflective question pool, shared so the backend question engine and the mobile client (pre-threshold, day-1 questions) rotate over identical content. Every entry must be a question (end with '?') and must contain no advice language (the word 'should' never appears) — both platforms pin these invariants by test. Expanded 2026-09-17 from 8 to 60 questions across evidence-informed reflective families (noticing, self-compassion, gratitude, meaning, emotion granularity, connection, energy, honest difficulty, curiosity) — every phrasing stays observational, never prescriptive.
